stat.arcanequest.agility.desc: +0.5% movement speed and +1% attack speed per point
stat.arcanequest.intelligence.desc: +5 max mana and +5% spell power per point
message.arcanequest.level_up: Level up! You are now level %s (+%s stat points, press K)
message.arcanequest.choose_class: You can choose your class! Press K, Skills tab.
class.arcanequest.mage.desc: Intelligence. +50% max mana and regeneration, +30% spell power.
class.arcanequest.assassin.desc: Agility. Critical hits x2, +10% attack speed, +10% speed.
spell.arcanequest.fire_bolt.desc: Burning bolt that sets the target on fire.
spell.arcanequest.frost_bolt.desc: Icy bolt that slows the target.
spell.arcanequest.arcane_missile.desc: Fast, strong bolt that weakens the target.
spell.arcanequest.lightning.desc: Calls lightning where you aim (32 blocks).
spell.arcanequest.arcane_barrage.desc: Fires 5 arcane missiles in a fan.
tooltip.arcanequest.summon: Use on a block to summon: %s
weapon.arcanequest.dagger.desc: Very fast. x1.75 damage from behind.
weapon.arcanequest.katana.desc: Fast. Right click: slashing dash forward.
weapon.arcanequest.longsword.desc: Two-handed, slow. Every hit cleaves enemies in front of you.
weapon.arcanequest.scythe.desc: Reaps every enemy around you and heals you.
screen.arcanequest.crafting_hint: For 3×3 recipes, use a crafting table.
screen.arcanequest.class_spend_points: Spend your stat points: the 3 classes offered depend on your stats.
message.arcanequest.class_unlocked: Level 20: you can choose your class! (K, Skills tab)
class.arcanequest.berserker.desc: Strength. +15% melee damage, +10% attack speed. Below half health: +30% damage.
class.arcanequest.paladin.desc: Strength + Vitality. +2 hearts, +2 armor, +10% melee damage. Each melee hit heals ½ heart.
class.arcanequest.guardian.desc: Vitality. +4 hearts, +4 armor, +2 toughness, +30% knockback resistance.
class.arcanequest.duelist.desc: Strength + Agility. +10% melee damage, +15% attack speed, critical hits x1.75.
class.arcanequest.ranger.desc: Agility + Vitality. +35% arrow damage, +10% speed, +1 heart.
class.arcanequest.spellblade.desc: Strength + Intelligence. +10% melee damage, +15% spell power. Each melee hit restores 2 mana.
class.arcanequest.cleric.desc: Vitality + Intelligence. +2 hearts, +10% spell power, heals x1.5, regenerates ½ heart every 4 s.
class.arcanequest.arcanist.desc: Agility + Intelligence. Spells cost 30% less, +10% spell power, +10% speed.
message.arcanequest.awakening: Level 50: AWAKENING! Your class can evolve (K, Skills tab)
class.arcanequest.monk.desc: Strength + Agility + Vitality. Bare-handed fighting: +5 damage without a weapon, +10% attack speed, +5% speed.
class.arcanequest.necromancer.desc: Intelligence + a bit of everything. 15% of killed monsters rise as shadow soldiers (3 max, 1 min). +10% spells.
class.arcanequest.warlord.desc: Berserker awakening. +2 hearts, +25% melee damage, +15% attack speed. Below half health: +50% damage.
class.arcanequest.executioner.desc: Berserker awakening. +20% melee damage, +10% attack speed. +60% damage against enemies below 30% health.
class.arcanequest.fortress.desc: Guardian awakening. +6 hearts, +6 armor, +4 toughness, +50% knockback resistance, -15% damage taken.
class.arcanequest.rune_guardian.desc: Guardian awakening. +5 hearts, +5 armor, +2 toughness. Reflects 30% of melee damage to the attacker.
class.arcanequest.ninja.desc: Assassin awakening. 25% chance to dodge an attack, critical hits x2, +20% speed, +15% attack speed.
class.arcanequest.shadow_assassin.desc: Assassin awakening. Critical hits x2.5. Invisible while sneaking. +15% attack speed, +10% speed.
class.arcanequest.archmage.desc: Mage awakening. Max mana and regeneration x2, +60% spell power.
class.arcanequest.elementalist.desc: Mage awakening. +50% mana, +40% spells. Every hit burns (3 s) and slows the enemy.
class.arcanequest.crusader.desc: Paladin awakening. +4 hearts, +4 armor, +15% melee damage. Each melee hit heals 1 heart.
class.arcanequest.holy_knight.desc: Paladin awakening. +3 hearts, +3 armor, +15% melee, heals ½ heart per hit. +60% damage against undead.
class.arcanequest.weapon_master.desc: Duelist awakening. +20% melee damage, +25% attack speed, critical hits x2.
class.arcanequest.windblade.desc: Duelist awakening. +20% speed, +20% attack speed, +15% melee, critical hits x1.75, 10% dodge.
class.arcanequest.sniper.desc: Ranger awakening. +70% arrow damage, +10% speed, +1 heart.
class.arcanequest.hunter.desc: Ranger awakening. +45% arrow damage, every hit slows, +15% speed, +2 hearts.
class.arcanequest.rune_knight.desc: Spellblade awakening. +20% melee, +30% spells, +2 armor. Each melee hit restores 4 mana.
class.arcanequest.warlock.desc: Spellblade awakening. +35% spells, +10% melee. Spells heal 25% of the damage dealt.
class.arcanequest.saint.desc: Cleric awakening. +3 hearts, +20% spells, heals x2.5, regenerates ½ heart every 2 s.
class.arcanequest.druid.desc: Cleric awakening. +4 hearts, +15% spells, heals x1.75, regeneration. Every hit poisons.
class.arcanequest.chronomancer.desc: Arcanist awakening. Spells cost 50% less, +20% spells, +15% speed.
class.arcanequest.battlemage.desc: Arcanist awakening. +30% spells, spells 25% cheaper, +10% melee and attack speed, +15% speed.
class.arcanequest.grandmaster.desc: Monk awakening. +10 bare-handed damage, +20% attack speed, +10% speed.
class.arcanequest.iron_monk.desc: Monk awakening. +7 bare-handed damage, +3 hearts, +6 armor, +30% knockback resistance.
class.arcanequest.lich_lord.desc: Necromancer awakening. 30% of killed monsters become stronger shadows (5 max, 2 min). +50% mana, +25% spells.
class.arcanequest.shadow_monarch.desc: Hidden class (defeat the Skeleton King). "Arise." 50% of killed monsters join your shadow army forever (8 max, very strong). +3 hearts, +15% melee, +20% spells, +10% speed.
screen.arcanequest.hidden_class: Hidden class: a secret condition must be met...
